mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, biz_key, revenue_delta, available_delta, frozen_delta, reason, status, retry_count, max_retry, next_retry_at, error_msg, created_at, updated_at FROM merchant_funds_message WHERE status = 'pending' AND retry_count < max_retry AND next_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_funds_message SET status = 'done', error_msg = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('pending', 'failed')
